source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Review the inspection report.
3. Determine what the problem is, if it is a failed compliance situation.
4. Record the name(s) of the Inspector(s) for the failed test.
5. Prepare the information to contact the local media, including radio, 
television and newspapers.
6. Prepare a written notification(s) to the local media, including radio, 
television and newspapers.
7. Notify the local water authority (if it is part of the municipality).
8. Record all information on a form in a secure file, including any 
attachments.
9. Follow the municipality's existing procedure of handling the notification.
10. Distribute the message to the public, through one or more of the 
media, both via television, radio, and newspaper.
11. Follow any subsequent steps, as needed.
12. Prepare and distribute a report of
